notes.title: Updates and new game!
notes.notes: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p]A new update is coming for the game with [b]improved graphics and Bug fixes[/b] soon next month and also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in an enhanced edition![/p][p] [/p][p]Meanwhile if you want to check out our [b]new upcoming adventure game[/b][/p][p]check it out, follow and add to wishlist here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]In this game you'll follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set sail with Mai and travel through time, journeying across both past and future, thanks to a Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Observe how the world transforms before your eyes and adapt your actions accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3499550/extras/Gif4.4_2.gif?t=1752767160"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay & A Deep Storyline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as Mai in the different stages of her life, harnessing the unique abilities in childhood and adolescence to face the challenges ahead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience a natural progression of gameplay mechanics, from precision platforming to hack and slash combat, while unlocking new abilities for Mai through Metroidvania-style progression, expanding her exploration and combat possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate, abandoned factories to discover and submerged worlds to explore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gather hidden clues with Mai to unravel the past, uncovering the events that led to humanity’s extinction, and discover what fate awaits the world after their disappearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The game is coming in September, stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]For more, stay tuned on our Discord Server:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel"]https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+ Today available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
I'm glad to announce that the sequel of Woodle Tree 2: Worlds is today available on Steam!

Check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173740/Woodle_Tree_2_Deluxe/

[h3]Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+ Features:
[/h3]

· A vast world to explore freely!

· Platforming sections completely redesigned for the most hardcore gamers in this new Deluxe Edition

· Fast paced new abilities and puzzles

· Power ups and items to upgrade Woodle and the helpful Leaf

· local co-op up to 4 players to experience the main adventure with your friends!

· New bizarre characters that you’ll meet meet during your quest: will they help or hinder you?


We took in consideration all your feedbacks on the first game, and improved in this new edition, let me know what you think!

notes.title: Woodle Tree 2 Update 0.9! - MMO Mode
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends! 
I'm happy to announce a new update for the game!  

We hope you're enjoying the game so far, we're constantly adding more and more content to the game based on your feedback! 

Here some of the new features with this release!
[b]
- MMO Alpha mode now available! (simply touch the 3 Woodle statue at the center of the plaza to enter MMO mode)

- Improved frame rate

let us know what would you like to see in the final version of the game! 
(to be released in semptember)
[/h1]
